final_message:
I fixed `LRUCache.get` in `src/lru.py`. I haven't run it or any tests.

`get` returned the stored value but never marked the key as recently used. After a `get`, that key kept its old place in the eviction order. A later `put` at capacity could then evict an entry that had just been read, so the cache returned `None` for it.

`get` now moves the key to the most-recently-used end of `self.order` before it returns the value. A missing key still returns `None`.

I only changed `get`. I didn't look at `put`, `__len__` or the rest of the file for other problems.
